Auth.//: Development serves the API over plain HTTP, and Safari refuses to store a Secure cookie on an insecure origin - even localhost, which Chrome and Firefox exempt. Without this the session cookie is silently dropped there and every authorized call comes back 401 right after a successful login. Only this file is affected; appsettings.json keeps CookieSecure=true, so deployed environments still require HTTPS.
